info.description: Core REST API. All endpoints are served under /api/v1.

graceHours.description: Hours the old key keeps working

systemCheckId.description: Row written by the worker in system_checks

roundTripMs.description: Enqueue-to-completion latency observed by the API

scopeId.description: Organization, team or repository id (not for TENANT)

from.description: Branch, tag or commit to branch from

pattern.description: Branch name or glob pattern, e.g. release/*

allowDirectPush.description: Allow pushes without a pull request

mergeable.description: False when there are conflicts with the base branch

stale.description: Review was made on an older commit

line.description: Line number on the new side of the diff

oldLine.description: Line number on the old side of the diff

token.description: Shown once. Use as the password for Git over HTTPS.

tenantId.description: Target workspace (may be the same workspace)

labelIds.description: Replaces all labels of the issue / pull request

milestoneId.description: Milestone id, or null to clear

target.description: Branch/commit used if the tag does not exist yet

report.description: Counts and per-file problems of the last run

content.description: Rule file content (YAML, sep.detection/v1 or Sigma)

xqlCaseSensitive.description: XQL input only: tenant case-sensitivity setting when the query has no config

sourceDialect.description: Required with "query"; taken from the rule otherwise

query.description: Query text (exactly one of query or rule)

fieldMappingSetId.description: Field mapping set of this organization

version.description: Current version; required when a policy exists

allowWarningRules.description: Allow rules whose validation status is WARNING

enforced.description: Require members to sign in through this IdP

ownerBypass.description: Owners may still sign in otherwise (break-glass)
